description: Land Acquisition - acquired the Lands in D/S Division, Ella, Haldummulla and Mahara
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, boundaries, and extents, with detailed descriptions of land plots in various districts. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the primary purpose of the document, which is land acquisition matters. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
